title: Yasiel Puig lost over $1.5 million in bets with unlicensed bookie, IRS agent testifies - Whatfinger News Quick Hits
text:
Puig told federal investigators during a January 2022 voluntary interview that he had lost some bets on a website he couldn’t remember and that he was told by an unknown person to make out $200,000 in cashiers’ checks to someone he didn’t know.
LOS ANGELES (CN) ‚Äî Former Major League Baseball slugger Yasiel Puig lost more than $1.5 million in sports bets he placed with an illegal bookmaker in Southern California over no more than five months in 2019, a criminal investigator with the Internal Revenue Service testified Wednesday.
